text:
maria.partnerships: Hey — Akash just sent an updated pricing pack. Need sharpened inputs for the cost model: reserved tiers, spot hourly med/95p, commit windows, and any min-commit floors. Can vendors confirm region parity?
akash.vendor: thanks maria. attaching region CSV in DM. High-level: we support 1/3/6/12mo reserved contracts. Marketplace SKUs live in us-west-2/us-east-1/eu-west-1 initially; ap-southeast on request. Spot is preemptible; historical preemption varies by region (avg 12%, tail to 25% in peak).
aj.platform: do we have published marketplace price IDs? i can wire them into the SKU->model mapping if so. also need GPU equivalence (A100-40h vs others).
akash.vendor: yes will share SKU list. for equivalence we report vCPU/RAM/GPU-memspec and a "A100-40h-equivalent" column.
sarah.finance: TL;DR for finance: we need effective $/GPU-hour after preemption+retry+margin. please provide: reserved_price_hourly, spot_price_hourly, avg_preempt_rate, 95p_preempt, min_commit_hours, early_termination_fee_pct, region.
tom.supply: also call out lead time for reservations (how soon capacity is guaranteed post-contract) — some vendors have 2w, some 6w. that's critical for modeled supply elasticity.
maria.partnerships: good point tom. akash, what's lead time for reserving dedicated blocks?
akash.vendor: lead time 2–3 weeks for standard stock in us-west. for guaranteed SKUs (enterprise carve-outs) it's 6–8 weeks. we can do expedited provisioning for a fee.
aj.platform: for spot modeling we need a distribution, not just mean. can you share hourly preempt samples for last 90 days or a 95/99 pctiles?
akash.vendor: i can provide daily preemption rates and a 95p sample. will redact customer IDs.
sarah.finance: also give us any committed discount ladders (e.g., 10% @3mo, 18% @6mo, 28% @12mo) and whether those are additive to marketplace baseline. show both list and net after marketplace cut.
akash.vendor: discount ladder example (net to us): 8% @3mo, 17% @6mo, 30% @12mo. marketplace cut already removed from those net numbers.
maria.partnerships: thanks. action items: 1) akash to drop SKU CSV + 90d preempt series + discount ladder by EOD Thursday. 2) finance to give target cost-per-effective-hour calc template. 3) platform to map SKU->instance-type equivalence.
sarah.finance: i pasted a quick calc in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder (see tab "vendor_inputs"). sample calc: 
```
effective_hours = provisioned_hours * (1 - preempt_rate)
retries_overhead = effective_hours * retry_multiplier (we assume 1.12)
cost_per_effective_hour = (reserved_hourly * provisioned_hours + ops_overhead) / (effective_hours - retries_overhead)
```
please comment on assumptions.
aj.platform: noted. i'd like a field for "fallback model cost" when spot unavailable (i.e., we spill to larger reserved pool). helps model worst-case tail cost.
tom.supply: any minimum financial commitments? some partners require a monthly minimum spend to keep carve-outs — if so we'll fold into unit economics.
akash.vendor: for enterprise carve-outs, there's a $25k/month minimum in EMEA, $15k/month in US. For smaller reserved buys via marketplace no min.
maria.partnerships: perfect. last ask: can we get region-specific uptime SLOs and maintenance windows (so we can simulate planned downtime)?
akash.vendor: region SLO: 99.7% for reserved carve-outs; marketplace-reserved 99.5%. maint windows published monthly. will include schedule.
sarah.finance: once we have the CSV i'll run Monte Carlo on preemption and produce a cost band (P10/P50/P90) for token cost. aim to share by next Tue.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace SKU sync scheduled for 2026-06-18 14:00 UTC.
maria.partnerships: thanks everyone. i'll track open items in the partnerships board and ping akash if anything missing. :thumbsup:
